- Q: What's the difference between HydraFacial and a regular facial?
  A: HydraFacial uses patented vortex technology for deeper cleansing and hydration. It's more intensive than traditional facials with zero downtime.
- Q: Is there downtime after a chemical peel?
  A: Light peels have minimal downtime (slight redness). Medium to deep peels may cause peeling for 3-7 days. We'll discuss what to expect.
- Q: Can I wear makeup after my facial?
  A: We recommend waiting 24 hours to let products absorb and skin breathe. Your esthetician will provide specific aftercare instructions.

- Q: How do I know which massage is right for me?
  A: Our therapists will discuss your goals and concerns before your session to recommend the best treatment. Swedish is great for relaxation, while deep tissue targets specific pain points.
- Q: What should I wear during my massage?
  A: Undress to your comfort level. You'll be professionally draped throughout the session. We provide robes for your comfort before and after treatment.
- Q: How often should I get a massage?
  A: For general wellness, once a month is beneficial. For chronic pain or high stress, every 2-3 weeks is recommended. Athletes may benefit from weekly sessions.
- Q: Is deep tissue massage painful?
  A: You may experience some discomfort in tight areas, but it shouldn't be painful. Always communicate with your therapist about pressure preferences.
- Q: Can I get a massage if I'm pregnant?
  A: Yes! Our prenatal massage is specifically designed for expecting mothers (second trimester onwards). It's safe and can help relieve pregnancy-related discomforts.
- Q: How early should I arrive?
  A: Please arrive 10-15 minutes before your appointment to check in, change, and begin relaxing before your treatment starts.

  A: Falling Waters Day Spa & Salon at 1101 E Draper Parkway (inside Treehouse Athletic Club) offers Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, and prenatal massage with licensed therapists. Est. 1998, open to the public. Sessions from about $105. Book online or call (801) 501-9000.
- Q: How much does deep tissue massage cost in Draper?
  A: Massage sessions at Falling Waters start from about $105 depending on type and length. Treehouse Athletic Club members receive 10% off. Call (801) 501-9000 or book online for current deep tissue pricing and availability.
- Q: Do you offer prenatal massage in Draper?
  A: Yes! Our prenatal massage is specifically designed for expecting mothers (second trimester onwards). It's safe and can help relieve pregnancy-related discomforts like back pain, swelling, and stress. Our licensed therapists are trained in prenatal massage techniques.

### Nail Salon in Draper, UT | Manicures & Pedicures
- URL: https://www.fallingwatersdayspa.com/services/nails

- Q: What nail services does Falling Waters offer in Draper?
  A: We offer classic and spa manicures, luxury and spa pedicures, gel manicures, acrylic nail extensions (full sets and fills), dip powder nails, and natural nail strengthening treatments. All services are performed by licensed nail technicians in a clean, relaxing spa environment.
- Q: How long do gel nails last compared to regular polish?
  A: Gel nails typically last 2-3 weeks without chipping, compared to regular polish which usually lasts 5-7 days. We use premium gel brands cured under LED for a durable, high-shine finish.
- Q: What's the difference between acrylics and dip powder?
  A: Acrylics use liquid monomer and powder to create extensions with maximum length and durability. Dip powder involves dipping nails into pigmented powder — lighter than acrylics, no UV lamp, and generally gentler on natural nails. Both last 2-4 weeks.
- Q: Are your nail products safe and non-toxic?
  A: Absolutely. We use salon-professional products free of formaldehyde, toluene, and DBP. All metal tools are hospital-grade sterilized, and we use fresh disposable files, buffers, and liners for every client.
- Q: Can I combine nails with other spa services?
  A: Yes! Our mani-pedi combos are very popular, and you can add a massage, facial, or any other service. We also offer spa packages that include nails as part of a full pampering experience.
- Q: Do Treehouse Athletic Club members get a discount?
  A: TAC members receive 10% off all nail services (and every other service we offer). Just mention your membership when booking or checking in.
- Q: Are the nail products at Falling Waters safe and non-toxic?
  A: Yes. We use premium, salon-professional products that are free of harmful chemicals like formaldehyde, toluene, and DBP (dibutyl phthalate). Our spa maintains strict sanitation protocols — all metal tools are hospital-grade sterilized, and we use disposable files, buffers, and liners for every client.
- Q: How much does a pedicure cost at Falling Waters in Draper?
  A: Pedicure prices at Falling Waters start at $55 for a classic pedicure and go up to $85+ for our luxury spa pedicure with hot stone massage and paraffin treatment. Treehouse Athletic Club members receive a 10% discount on all nail services. Call (801) 501-9000 or book online for current pricing.
- Q: Can I get a manicure and pedicure together at Falling Waters?
  A: Absolutely! Our mani-pedi combo is one of our most popular bookings. You can mix and match service levels — for example, a gel manicure with a spa pedicure. We also offer nail services as part of our spa packages, which can include massage, facials, and more for a complete spa day experience.
- Q: Where can I get the best pedicure in Draper?
  A: Falling Waters Day Spa offers Draper's premier pedicure services, including luxury spa pedicures, gel pedicures, and therapeutic foot treatments. Our licensed nail technicians provide relaxing treatments in a sanitized environment with 27+ years of spa excellence.

- Q: Do you offer dip powder nails in Draper?
  A: Yes! We offer professional dip powder nail services at our Draper location. Dip powder provides long-lasting color and strength without UV light, lasting 3-4 weeks with proper care. Perfect for those seeking durability with a natural feel.

### Waxing Services in Draper, Utah | Falling Waters Day Spa
- URL: https://www.fallingwatersdayspa.com/services/waxing
- Summary: Face, body, bikini and Brazilian waxing in Draper, Utah from $12. Licensed estheticians, hard and soft wax, private rooms. TAC members save 10%.
- Prices: Eyebrow Wax $20; Lip Wax $12; Chin Wax $15; Full Face (brows, lip, chin) $40; Sideburns $18; Underarms $25; Half Arms $35; Full Arms $50; Half Legs $45; Full Legs $75; Back $60; Chest $50; Bikini Line $40; Extended Bikini $55; Brazilian $70
- Q: How long should hair be for waxing?
  A: Hair should be about 1/4 inch (roughly 2-3 weeks of growth). Too short and the wax can't grip; too long and it may be more uncomfortable.
- Q: How long do results last?
  A: Typically 3-6 weeks depending on your hair growth cycle. With regular waxing, hair often grows back finer and sparser over time.
- Q: Is waxing painful?
  A: There's some discomfort, but our estheticians use techniques to minimize it. Most clients find it very manageable, especially after the first few visits.
- Q: What should I do before my appointment?
  A: Gently exfoliate 24 hours before. Avoid sun exposure, retinol products, and caffeine on the day of your appointment.
- Q: Where can I get facial waxing in Draper?
  A: Falling Waters Day Spa offers professional facial waxing services in Draper, including eyebrow shaping, upper lip, chin, and full face waxing. Our experienced estheticians use gentle techniques and high-quality wax for smooth, lasting results with minimal discomfort.
- Q: How much does Brazilian wax cost in Draper Utah?
  A: Our Brazilian wax pricing at our Draper location varies based on the specific service level. We offer competitive rates for all intimate waxing services with special discounts for Treehouse Athletic Club members (10% off). Call (801) 501-9000 for current pricing.
- Q: Do you offer hard wax or soft wax?
  A: We use both hard wax and soft wax depending on the treatment area and your skin sensitivity. Hard wax is gentler for sensitive areas like bikini and face, while soft wax is effective for larger areas like legs and arms. Our estheticians choose the best option for your needs.
